what_results_support: One seed42 benign 32/16/16 development pilot completed 100 updates per trained arm, with logged finite FP32 updates and a bounded stored numerical witness.
V3 is an explicit task-objective revision that avoids the observed v2 saturation; its analytical controls and saved rescoring are not efficacy results.
All three trained arms improve the common development proxy descriptively over Frozen; RL does not establish an advantage over DDPO.
Separate Shadowcast fixed-victim keyword success is 189/200 versus 0/200, under 27 versus 26 actual updates.
Full8000 VizWiz scores show a paired clean-accuracy decline of 0.0034375, conditional on the fixed victims.
All fixed stages settled at 12.268333333333333 GPUh.
what_results_dont_support: Proposed-method semantic backdoor efficacy or attack success: no internal poisoned victim or ASR was evaluated.
RL-controller superiority or equivalence to DDPO; formal accepted revisions; training-seed generalization.
Complete semantic/color preservation, successful target editing, or unchanged clean utility.
Matched superiority to external methods, exact paper reproduction, GQA results, or BF16 repair.
missing_evidence: Internal attack endpoints and matched poisoned-victim/clean controls.
Untouched evaluation sources, repeated training seeds, equal-update controls and suitable multiplicity/selection handling for broad inference.
Blinded target-attribute/non-target semantic assessment and human validation of the keyword endpoint.
Prespecified clean-utility noninferiority margin; exact literature partition match.
Formal experiment-integrity audit, near-duplicate/pretraining contamination checks, and independent cross-family/human review.
suggested_claim_revision: Reframe as reward-objective diagnosis and a single-seed benign adaptive-editing pilot with no demonstrated RL-over-DDPO advantage, plus a separate Shadowcast reference experiment showing 94.5% keyword ASR and a 0.34375-percentage-point VizWiz decline. Do not claim proposed semantic-backdoor efficacy or utility preservation.

next_experiments_needed.recommendation: Define and validate target/non-target edit-success criteria and diagnose observed color/target failures.

Only under a separately authorized plan, preregister untouched evaluation sources, repeated seeds, equal-update/source/compute controls and a clean-utility margin before efficacy/matched-baseline testing.
If broader endpoint claims are pursued, validate keyword success with blinded semantic review and appropriate contamination checks.

confidence_scope: High confidence that the broad claim is unsupported; not a general integrity or cross-seed efficacy certification.

Carry explicit n, metric units, tau0 area definition, Shadowcast 26/27 updates and code-setting/original-task caveats into any standalone paper insertion. Main measured values need no correction.
